title: Understanding Cross-Validation
text: Cross-validation is a technique used to assess how the results of a statistical analysis will generalize to an independent data set. It is mainly used in scenarios where we want to evaluate the performance of a model.

title: Common Uses of Cross-Validation
text: Cross-validation is commonly used for hyperparameter tuning, model selection, and assessing model generalization. It helps in comparing different models and selecting the best one based on their performance on unseen data.

title: Limitations of Cross-Validation
text: Cross-validation is not typically used to find solutions when the design matrix is not full column rank. This is more related to issues of multicollinearity and matrix algebra rather than model evaluation.
